records.body:
Hi Ines,

We know getting started can slip. If you want a hand setting up your first project or inviting your team, just reply -- happy to help.

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Maple Labs!
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Maple Labs* just joined on the pro plan!

decisions.rationale: Positive, engaged reply (email:8c4400ab) and an invite already sent show intent, but no project after 6 days and only a vague "at some point" on a call; no tickets. 8 days left gives room, so moderate-low odds unaided.

draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Maple Labs' setup
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Glad to hear things are going well, and good news on the teammate joining you. The walkthrough offer stands whenever you want it.

If it's useful, I can hold a short call this week to get your first project set up with you — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so that's usually the step that makes everything else click. Just tell me a time that suits and I'll work around it.

Best,
Priya
